Based on the retrieved documents for Solicitation SOL-2026-CLOUD-01, here are the answers to your questions:

* **CLIN-0004-AB Base Hourly Rate and Year 1 Base Ceiling (Prior to Amendments):** 
  Prior to any contract amendments, the base solicitation hourly rate for CLIN-0004-AB (Cloud Security Architect) is **$210.00/hr** (also written as $210/hr) (`01_RFP_Base_Solicitation.pdf`, p. 1; `04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf`, p. 1; `06_Amendment_0001_Scope_Update.pdf`, p. 1). For the estimated 2,000 base hours, the Year 1 base ceiling (Year 1 Total) is **$420,000.00** (also written as $420,000) (`01_RFP_Base_Solicitation.pdf`, p. 1; `04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf`, p. 1).

* **Mandatory Cloud KMS Key Rotation Period (Amendment 0002, Q12):** 
  Under FedRAMP High for BigQuery and Cloud SQL volumes, all Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) in Cloud HSM must enforce an automated **90-day rotation schedule**, or a **30-day rotation** for Tier-0 identity signing keys (`07_Amendment_0002_Vendor_QA.pdf`, p. 1).

The $210.00/hr rate and $420,000 Year 1 ceiling come from 04_Pricing_Schedule and 01_RFP SEC-4.3.2, and the 90-day (30-day Tier-0) CMEK rotation comes from 07_Amendment_0002 Q12/A12. The answer fully matches the reference, but retrieval includes several off-target chunks (SOL-2026-SEC-03 MSA and labor card, SOL-2026-DATA-02 addendum, SOW waves, vendor proposal, evaluation factors) alongside the four relevant ones.
